verdict.rationale: ChatGPT is itself the built-in assistant, and its docs describe handing it larger tasks. Work mode carries a task "through to a reviewable result", Goal mode supports long-running work, and the assistant can delegate to subagents, start tasks by voice, and run scheduled or event-triggered background tasks. The community evidence is general chat praise rather than hands-on reports of task delegation, so it adds little. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the delegation features (Work mode, Goal mode, subagents).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Turn on Work in the switcher when you want ChatGPT to carry a larger task through to a reviewable result.
In ChatGPT Work, ask ChatGPT to delegate independent work to subagents.
In the ChatGPT desktop app, enter `/goal` to start Goal mode.
ChatGPT Voice can start separate tasks for longer work, check existing tasks, and send follow-up instructions.
Schedule recurring tasks to run in the background... Review active, paused, and completed tasks and recent runs in Scheduled.
Run projects in parallel, work with files, use your computer, and keep long-running work moving from one desktop workspace.
